The UGREEN 35347 Emergency Escape Tool is a must-have for every vehicle, combining a spring-powered window breaker and seatbelt cutter to save lives during accidents or submersion. The rigid spring pressurization mechanism generates enough force to instantly shatter tempered glass with minimal effort, while the stainless steel cutter cleanly slices through jammed seatbelts without risking injury.

Designed for panic-free operation, its transparent housing ensures quick visibility in dark or murky conditions. The compact, lightweight body fits in cup holders or attaches to sun visors for immediate access. Ideal for parents, commuters, and fleet vehicles, this tool adheres to global safety standards and includes a 1-year warranty.
